name: Kirita Atsuko
source:
A junior high school genius with an IQ of 200 who works as Takamiya's assistant. 

[spoiler]She is a test-tube baby created by KOKON experiment, by mixing superior genes, and as is customary, she takes Kirita as a surname (derived from KOKON's official name “Kirita Pharmaceuticals”).[/spoiler]
